changes.rationale: The actual diagram places J at the upper endpoint of radius OJ, with O,G,H,J in order and H halfway from G to J. Put t=JG>0, so OG=a-t and OH=a-t/2. The chord lengths are CD=2*sqrt(2at-t^2) and EF=2*sqrt(at-t^2/4). The positive common height cancels from the trapezoid/rectangle ratio, leaving (1+sqrt((2a-t)/(a-t/4)))/2. Its one-sided limit as t tends to 0 is (1+sqrt(2))/2=1/2+1/sqrt(2), D. Preserve the reviewed B elementary-function-limits target and D geometric cancellation route, with exact publication gates. Actual h216 covers a concrete average-to-instantaneous-rate process, not this general endpoint limit. Both areas vanish at the endpoint, so direct endpoint division is invalid.
